name: sel
definition: The rows that match a pattern on their fields (family, signer, subject, target, any body field; a value or a set of accepted values) and were first held strictly before an instant.
status: existing: every model's filter over held rows; the row atom of tools/guard_grammar.py (family set, state, joins, `at` instant). A lower bound on first-held is missing here and is a parameter (the grammar has `after(POLICY)`)

name: group
signature: (rows, by, how, val) -> {key: value} or one value
definition: Group rows by a field and reduce each group to its least row, its greatest row, its single distinct value (a group with two is dropped), or its count of distinct values.
parameters: by (a field, or none for one group); how = least | greatest | one | count; val (a field or tuple of fields, default first-held)
status: existing: least/greatest in takedown, deletion, set_item and the guard quant `latest`; one in owner_binding, ranked_choice dedupe, set_item fork; count in ranked_choice and the policy rows. A sum reducer is missing here; ranked_choice already writes it (merge, round_totals), so it is a parameter

name: in_range
definition: Whether lo <= x < hi, where an absent lo is an interval never opened (false) and an absent hi one not yet closed.
parameters: none; x, lo, hi are instants or counts
status: existing: takedown under_hold, deletion close, set_item freshness; the guard `within`/`after` window and the clock rows of manifests/reactions.json

name: rule
definition: The cell a typed manifest gives for a key: a window, a basis class, a role set, a threshold, a key effect.
status: existing: manifests/reactions.json, transitions.json, namespace_registry.json, constants.tsv, the policy table

name: fix
definition: Apply a step until the state stops changing, at most bound times.
status: partly: written once, as the runoff loop of ranked_choice (and the `again` loop of owner_binding, a reading not taken); no model uses it over rows

name: live
definition: The rows matching `open` that no row matching `close` for them (same signer or naming them), held before the bound, answers.
parameters: the join between an opener and its closer; before
status: existing: takedown undone, owner_binding withdrawn, deletion met, guardianship refusal; the guard states withdrawn, recanted, superseded

name: first / latest
definition: The earliest or latest held row of a kind.
status: existing: takedown hold_from, deletion start; guard quant `latest`

name: count
definition: Distinct voices among the rows of a kind.

name: owner
definition: The one owner the live cosigned bindings name; none when they name none or two.

name: under
definition: Whether t is under the interval opened by the earliest row of one kind and closed by the earliest of another.

name: reach
signature: (rows, from, edge, roots) -> bool or path
definition: Whether a chain of live edge rows leads from a key to a root (the trust set, a duty); a cycle is reach from a key to itself.
status: partly: named by the guard key atom ROLE(KEY, TARGET, via=VIA) and the role tokens of transitions.json; no checked model walks a chain. The one function the sites need that no model runs

name: runoff
signature: (ballot rows, options, floor) -> winner or none
definition: Instant runoff: one ballot per person, then rounds of first standing choices until one has more than half.
composed_from: L5(L2, L2, L2, L3) over L2
